E1_raw_compact: task/phase/time, arm q, gripper, EEF pose, candidate action chunk
E2_object_centric: task/phase/time, EEF, padded task-object poses and relative positions, candidate action chunk
E3_contact_aware: E2 plus reference contact count and task/gripper/support contact flags
E4_short_history: E3 plus five-step reference physical history
E5_separate_specialists: independently regularized contact, motion, and outcome predictors
E6_shared_small: small shared MLP with consequence heads
RICH20: 20-step EEF, task-object, coarse-contact and predicate future output
